Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.numerics

Class SignedFaceComplementarity

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.numerics.SignedFaceComplementarity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
final class SignedFaceComplementarity extends Object implements Serializable
Compressed signed-face complementarity block for conservative phase transport.

Every internal gas, oil and water face owns three auxiliary variables: nonnegative signed-direction mass-flow magnitude, advective momentum flux and a nonnegative donor-presence multiplier. The direction and the active donor row are frozen while a Jacobian is assembled, then refreshed from the unmodified free flux between Newton linearizations. A present donor uses the normalized conservative relation between mass and momentum transport; an absent donor pins advective momentum to zero exactly. Replacing the free internal flux in both adjacent cells preserves total mass and momentum without clipping either cell inventory.

This class owns algebra and layout only. UnsplitTransientSolver decides when an active set may be refreshed and whether a trial step is admissible.
